reviews.t: Patience wins and you will get nice nails
reviews.x: i rarely write reviews. but felt the need to write one for this producd. I have tried a few different products for my nails, dipping powder, pink and white powder like they do in the salons, and now this product. this one was by far the easiest and my nails came out great. as long as you follow the instructions you will be fine. It comes with 3 builders, clear, white and pink. I used the clear then one coat of pink and it was close to looking like a natural nail. you can clean the builder brush

reviews.t: Takes practice, but definitely worth it!
reviews.x: I have tried more than my fair share of nail products trying to cut down the money I spent frequently going to the salon. This kit is HANDS DOWN the best purchase. Yes, it does take practice, AND patience, but once you get those, you will love them! I have tried the fiberglass fabric, and with constantly washing dishes at work, they never felt strong or lasted. I've already purchased this exact kit 2x due to its nail durability. Definitely recommend!

How do I get the instructions for using this? Which bottle is the builder gel? I have three bottles and don't know which one is which. Nothing is labeled correctly!
This product actually works. Long lovely nails. Takes awhile, but its worth it. Had to change clothes afterwards, because of the product getting under my skin.

I bought this because I was wanting to try fiberglass without spending a ton on something I might hate. I definitely do not hate these nails! They are thin and natural looking, and still super strong. I will absolutely continue using fiberglass nails.  BUT... They are a bit of a pain to use, and some of that pain is actual, physical pain from getting fiberglass stuck in your skin. I'd advise using gloves, and will follow my own advice on that going forward. Fiberglass is actual wee little glass

reviews.t: Easy to use and fast Prime shipping.
reviews.x: I didn’t purchase this for the fiberglass, but for the clear builder gel for my natural nails as an overlay. No, there aren’t any instructions but YouTube exists. If you’re truly lost, just go to the salon.

I was very excited to try this product and a clip came broken which wasnt a big deal but the entire bag was covered in one of the bottles of polish so everything was coated and sticky. Very upset. I'm a disabled veteran and doing my nails in bed is the most joy I can get some weeks so this just really upset me. It also didnt come with instructions like it said it would in the description but I guess that is what YouTube is good for.

reviews.t: Not as easy as it looks
reviews.x: No instructions and did not work out right. Going to the salon...ugh

reviews.t: Fibers made me VERY ITCHY. But the kit had and did what it said
reviews.x: Kit was nice, came with everything it said. The UV lamp was smaller than I expected, but for the price I'm not even mad at it and it works just fine. My only problem with it, which is a pretty big issue for me, is the way the fibers made me itch. The fibers felt like they were stabbing me and were so itchy I had to do a top to bottom clean of the space I used the kit in, even used a lint roller on the area as well as swept and mopped.

I really like this product,which look very natural and bend like a natural nail without breaking off.It took me a few times to get the hang of doing my own nails. if you don't know how to do , it's better to see Youtube Videos.
This is a great starter kit for doing your own fiberglass nails
The kid is perfect, but the nails is not secure
Takes some practice but this kit is great!

while putting on the  extension, I felt like I was being shocked. Started itching right away, and had to find a way to take out the extensions. Changed my tank top three times, due to the shocking sensation. Managed to take off the extension, and I'm still felling the shock, and still itching. Not to mention the company did not add the top coat to my package.  If you are sensitive, or think you might have an allergic reaction, do not use. reviews.t: Fiberglass slivers all over in my skin
reviews.x: Very hard to use especially if you have never done nails before. I’m itching everywhere and feel like I have fiberglass slivers in my skin all over not sure if I’ll try them again if this is the aftermath. They feel like they will stay on well but these slivers of fiberglass in my skin just isn’t worth it

reviews.t: Broken clip and light didnt work.
reviews.x: Opened it up and the clip was broken and the light doesn't work...Not happy...I won't buy this again and I don't want a replacement...This was to have been a Christmas present to me from my son so since we don't have alot of money to spend and we can't return it this is a bummer and really are not happy.

If i would have known that I definitely wouldn’t have wasted my money. But luckily its a Christmas gift and I can make do with it and make it one whole gift will have to do.

reviews.x: I have tried using this kit, first had problem with the gel lamp and secondly the gel that came with the fiber doesn’t worked.  I am trying it again I have several set of fiber so I just purchased a fiber builder now.  Wish me luck.

I paid for 2 day shipping over a week ago. I just got it today, I got two base coats and no top coat.. the picture is deceiving. It really makes it look like you get more out of the fiberglass than you actually get.

Perfect kit comes with everything!! I just followed a YouTube tutorial. Simple easy beautiful nails! The LED lamp is small and portable which is AMAZING!

claims.text: Many reviewers say the kit takes practice and patience, but is worth it once you get the hang of it.
Several reviewers complain that the kit lacks instructions or proper labeling, making it hard to know how to use it.
Reviewers praise the results, saying the nails look natural and are strong.
Some reviewers report problems with the product itself, such as itching from the fibers, nails not staying secure, or a broken/leaking shipment.
